description: Source code for role management in Mattermost, including role retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, permission merging, and event broadcasting.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with role management methods.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct with method for merging permissions.

methods.name: GetRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role by ID, handling not found and server errors, and merges higher scoped permissions.

methods.name: GetAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles and merges higher scoped permissions.

methods.name: GetRoleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a role by name within a context, with permission merging.

methods.name: GetRolesByNames
methods.description: Retrieves multiple roles by their names and merges permissions.

methods.name: DeleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role by ID, handling not found and server errors.

methods.name: mergeChannelHigherScopedPermissions
methods.description: Merges higher scoped permissions into roles based on scheme management.

methods.name: PatchRole
methods.description: Updates a role with a patch, triggers event if updated.

methods.name: CreateRole
methods.description: Creates a new role with default properties.

methods.name: UpdateRole
methods.description: Saves and updates a role, handles impact on related roles, and broadcasts events.

methods.name: sendUpdatedRoleEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts role update events to relevant teams or channels based on scope.
